research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: CAST AI is researching and developing systems for executing workloads across multiple cloud service providers, as described in 'Executing workloads across multiple cloud service providers.' This work highlights CAST AI’s focus on multi-cloud workload management and network optimization.

CAST AI is the leading Kubernetes automation platform that cuts AWS, Azure, and GCP customers’ cloud costs by over 50%. 

CAST AI goes beyond monitoring clusters and making recommendations. The platform utilizes advanced machine learning algorithms to analyze and automatically optimize clusters in real time, reducing customers’ cloud costs, improving performance and security, and boosting DevOps and engineering productivity.

about_short_description.short_description: CAST AI is the leading Kubernetes automation platform that cuts AWS, Azure, and GCP customers’ cloud costs by over 50%

product.name: CAST AI Platform
product.description: A Kubernetes automation platform that continuously analyzes workload, infrastructure, cost, and performance signals to optimize cloud-native applications across public, hybrid, and on-premises environments.

product.name: Application Performance Automation (APA) Platform
product.description: An automation platform for Kubernetes and cloud applications that uses workload, infrastructure, cost, and SLO signals to improve performance, reliability, and efficiency through automated actions and approved remediation runbooks.

product.name: Kubernetes Cost and Performance Monitoring
product.description: A monitoring and analytics service that provides visibility into actual, requested, and provisioned Kubernetes usage and costs by cluster, namespace, workload, team, CPU, memory, and GPU.

product.name: Kubernetes Workload Optimization
product.description: An automated workload rightsizing service that adjusts CPU, memory, requests, limits, and replica counts according to observed Kubernetes application behavior.

product.name: Kubernetes Infrastructure Automation
product.description: An infrastructure automation service that provisions and consolidates Kubernetes compute, selects suitable instance types, uses Spot capacity, and scales clusters according to workload demand.

product.name: GPU Optimization
product.description: A set of Kubernetes services for improving GPU utilization, scaling GPU workloads, sharing GPU capacity, and providing GPU cost visibility and cross-cloud access.
